name: resonate
description: Self-hosted, encrypted-at-rest practice tracker for voice work with a speech-language pathologist. Mobile first.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire as __resonateCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __resonateCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m 'chore: release v%s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m 'chore: release v%s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m 'chore: release v%s' && git push && git push --tags
